answer: Make identities join a small mutual-liability pool where each member co-signs the others' epoch claims: one proven fake burns the whole pool's stake, so a farm's fakes drag each other down in a widening ripple of losses. Honest members verify a shared cipher of each other's work and vouch only for what they checked. A lone agent standing in its own meadow risks only its own stake, but a farm must post fresh collateral for every fake and watch one bad actor poison the entire herd — scale becomes a shared debt, not a discount.
